_comment: Manifest for prompt_bank/. One entry per prompt: id (also the file stem), mode, frames on the 17k+5 grid, donor stem for ref2va (the shipped graph whose sockets the labels are graded against), and a one-line brief saying what the prompt was written to exercise. bench/build_prompt_bank.py grades every entry and derives docs/prompt_bank.md; run it after adding or editing one.
